account.homeText: Start with your profile, then use these shortcuts for events, messages, partner search and stories. Each section has its own short guide the first time you visit.
account.eventsText: Create a social, regular class, workshop or masterclass. You can add its location, schedule and dance styles.
account.schoolsText: Set your profile type to School, then publish classes and events under its name. School managers can also publish stories and manage school spaces in the admin panel.
account.shareText: Open Announcement Studio to create a portrait, story or square PNG for Instagram and WhatsApp. On a phone, use Share image to open the system share sheet.
account.profileText: Add your city and dance styles. You control separately whether each style appears in partner search.
account.communityText: Browse events, classes and schools without filling everything in at once. Open a section to get tips for that task.

event.introText: Give it a title and a few lines of description. The form below takes about two minutes.
event.detailsText: Choose a clear title, city and dance style. Add tags for the format, level and intensity so dancers can filter the listing.
event.placeText: Click the map, or choose the country and city and find the address. The marker is required: put it on the exact spot, especially for parks and squares.
event.scheduleTitle: Set the time and repeat pattern
event.scheduleText: Enter the local date and time for the selected city, then choose a one-off or recurring schedule.
event.publishText: You can save as a draft or publish. Check the marker on the map before you publish.

schools.createText: There is no separate school form. Set your profile type to School in your profile, add its public details, and then publish classes or events in its name.
schools.listText: Filter schools by city, open a profile and check its weekly timetable, special events and venues.
schools.claimTitle: Take ownership of an existing profile
schools.claimText: Open an unclaimed school profile and use its claim request. A moderator reviews ownership before management access is granted.
schools.adminText: A school profile owner can publish classes, events and posts in the school's name. School resource and staff administration lives in the separate admin panel; a platform owner or global admin must grant the School Admin role first. The admin link appears in the site header after access is granted.

share.fieldsText: Enter the title, date, place and short description. Add a photo and adjust its crop if you like.
share.sizeText: Use post, story or square dimensions depending on where you will publish it.
share.exportText: On supported phones, Share image opens the system sheet so you can choose Instagram or WhatsApp. Otherwise download the PNG and copy the caption.
